title: Project Control Superpowers Docs Retirement Checklist

items.label: Capture the Project Control cleanup path and owner before editing.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, and Evidence target are identified before editing Project Control docs/superpowers.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup, owner repo-project-control, active role documentation-synthesizer, phase target phase-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-project-control-superpowers-retirement, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-project-control-superpowers-retirement, and evidence target evidence-project-control-superpowers-docs-retired-2026-09-01.

items.label: Write failing Project Control documentation authority guards.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Project Control documentation authority tests fail before docs/superpowers is retired and before Project Control records the retirement evidence.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included npx vitest run tests/documentation-authority-policy.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failing because docs/superpowers still contained 21 Markdown files, then failing because Work requiredEvidence did not include evidence-project-control-superpowers-docs-retired-2026-09-01.

items.label: Move the active Project Control design into canonical domain docs.
items.evidenceTarget: The active doc-project-control-design path no longer points under docs/superpowers and the moved design remains readable through the generated read model.
items.verificationNote: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-12-flowdoc-project-control-design.md moved to docs/domains/flowdoc-project-control-architecture-and-gui-design-2026-08-12.md, and data/documents/project-control-design.json now points to that canonical domain path.

items.label: Record retained value and discard rationale before retirement.
items.evidenceTarget: A Project Control summary document lists the source snapshot, moved design path, retired historical traces, retained authority, and discard rationale.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/project-control-superpowers-retirement-2026-09-01.md records the source snapshot at Project Control commit 32ca1fe1207c68710382d4198493616e0c086ec6, the 2026-08-12 design move, and retained-value or discard rationale for the remaining historical execution traces.

items.label: Retire Project Control docs/superpowers Markdown files.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control docs/superpowers contains no Markdown after the active design move and historical source retirement.
items.verificationNote: rg --files docs/superpowers -g '*.md' reports the path is absent after Project Control commit 89d68b571ff4f815a99a5e53efc09252258c08e1.

items.label: Verify the Project Control cleanup guards and generated read model.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused documentation authority tests, seed tests, npm run generate, and npm run check:data pass after the Project Control docs/superpowers retirement.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence passed npx vitest run tests/documentation-authority-policy.test.ts tests/seed-project.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 with 2 files and 15 tests before this evidence record was added, then passed the same focused command with 2 files and 16 tests after record registration. npm run generate and npm run check:data also passed.

items.label: Record Project Control docs/superpowers retirement evidence without promoting product truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control evidence cites the implementation commit, files, verification, and boundaries intentionally not promoted.
items.verificationNote: Evidence is work-scoped with nodeIds [] and keeps Core, Backend, Editor, compatibility, frontend readiness, FlowDoc product truth, and map truth unpromoted.
